Fit & Fabric

  • Fit Type: Loose relaxed cropped fit; asymmetric one-shoulder cut brings unique visual focal point, oversized balloon sleeves add romantic dramatic volume, short crop hem optimizes body proportion to pair perfectly with high-waisted bottoms

Precise torque control:

Tracking mode: Real time display of applied torque, dynamic monitoring of tightening process.

Premium Material: 
Made of food-grade polypropylene, this sediment filter is tested against NSF/ANSI 42 standards and delivers high standards of safety. Its melt-blown construction ensures no fiber shedding, giving you a reliable and clean water filtration solution.

Engineered with three distinct density layers, this melt‑blown cartridge captures particles throughout its entire depth—not just on the surface. Unlike standard single‑layer filters, this design holds more sediment, extends filter life, and keeps water flowing steadily.
